config_validation_guards: Missing, null, empty, or blank routes list in collector-news-rss raises CollectorConfigError('source collector-news-rss requires a non-empty routes list in fetch-policy.json')
Duplicate routes in collector-news-rss raise CollectorConfigError('source collector-news-rss routes must not contain duplicates')
Routes count exceeding max_requests_per_run raises CollectorConfigError('source collector-news-rss routes count (...) exceeds max_requests_per_run=10')
Routes referencing DISABLED_BY_BUILD tokens (yahoo, cnyes, anue) or /ptt raise CollectorConfigError
Active routes overlapping disabled_routes raise CollectorConfigError('source collector-news-rss active routes cannot include disabled_routes ...')

per_route_isolation_and_deduplication.per_route_error_recording: Each route's HTTP error (non-200 status, FetchAccessBlockedError 403/429, or transport exception) or invalid XML (ET.ParseError or non-RSS root element) is recorded under route_errors[norm_route] in the poller, bundle manifest.json, and status.json without aborting, blocking, or auto-pausing the remaining routes.
per_route_isolation_and_deduplication.all_routes_failed_behavior: When succeeded_routes == 0 and route_errors is non-empty, all_routes_failed is true and CollectorRunner.run_source writes a partial bundle (status='partial', reason='fetch_failed' or 'parse_failed', items=[]) and records state.last_status='partial'.
per_route_isolation_and_deduplication.cross_route_article_deduplication: Articles are deduplicated across routes within a run by item_id, guid, and article link so an article served by both /cna/aie and /cna/asc (or both /udn/news/breakingnews/6 and /udn/news/breakingnews/11) is stored once.

collector_host_image_rebuild_and_readbac.why_image_rebuild_is_required: deploy/collector/Dockerfile copies collector_stack/ into /app/collector_stack at image build time (COPY collector_stack /app/collector_stack), while docker-compose.yml bind-mounts ./fetch-policy.json:/app/fetch-policy.json:ro. Both copying deploy/collector/. to /opt/pantheon-collector/ and rebuilding pantheon-collector-worker:1.0.0 are required for scheduled runs to use the updated RssHubNewsPoller, CollectorRunner, and validate_collector_config code.
collector_host_image_rebuild_and_readbac.step_2_sync_collector_files_and_rebuild_: sudo cp -a deploy/collector/. /opt/pantheon-collector/ && cd /opt/pantheon-collector && sudo docker compose build collector-worker
collector_host_image_rebuild_and_readbac.step_3_validate_config_and_code_readback: cd /opt/pantheon-collector && sudo docker compose run --rm collector-worker --policy-file /app/fetch-policy.json validate-config && sudo docker compose run --rm --entrypoint python3 collector-worker -c 'import inspect, json; from collector_stack.config import load_collector_config; from collector_stack.pollers import RssHubNewsPoller; p = load_collector_config("/app/fetch-policy.json").get_source("collector-news-rss"); print(json.dumps({"source_id": p.source_id, "policy_hash": p.policy_hash, "routes": p.raw_config["routes"], "disabled_routes": p.raw_config["disabled_routes"], "verified_routes": sorted(RssHubNewsPoller.VERIFIED_ROUTES), "collect_routes_default": inspect.signature(RssHubNewsPoller.collect).parameters["routes"].default}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))'
collector_host_image_rebuild_and_readbac.step_4_trigger_run_and_bundle_readback: sudo systemctl start pantheon-collector@collector-news-rss.service && jq '.sources["collector-news-rss"]' /var/lib/pantheon-collector/status.json && LATEST_MANIFEST="$(ls -1t /var/lib/pantheon-collector/bundles/collector-news-rss/*/*/manifest.json | head -n 1)" && jq '{run_id, status, reason, route_errors, item_count: (.items | length)}' "$LATEST_MANIFEST" && jq -r '.metrics.route' "$(dirname "$LATEST_MANIFEST")/items.jsonl" | sort | uniq -c
collector_host_image_rebuild_and_readbac.rollback_command: sudo docker tag pantheon-collector-worker:previous pantheon-collector-worker:1.0.0 && cd /opt/pantheon-collector && sudo docker compose run --rm collector-worker --policy-file /app/fetch-policy.json validate-config
